Hero_Desc_Miro:
A mirror Elemental who likes secretly watching and encouraging others from inside mirrors.
Because she unintentionally startles people, she is often mistaken for a ghost in the mirror.
She struggles to clear up the misunderstanding and make friends in the outside world she admires.
Album_Wish_Miro: To make many friends she can watch openly
Album_Miro1: Miro is a mirror Elemental who loves observing others. One day, I felt an intense gaze and turned to find her watching me. She shamelessly pretended otherwise, then fled when I confronted her.
Album_Miro2: Miro lives inside mirrors and secretly travels among them to observe the residents' daily lives. I suddenly wondered what I had done in front of mirrors all this time. Miro merely nodded.
Album_Miro3: Outside mirrors, Miro often staggers and falls. She cannot distinguish left from right there, but continues trying to learn how to walk properly on her own.
Album_Miro4: Miro excels at imitating others, apparently thanks to years spent watching residents through mirrors. Arco noticed her talent and even invited her to practice choreography together.
Album_Miro5: Miro learned many residents' secrets while traveling between mirrors. Some talk constantly to themselves, while others laugh alone at their own jokes. For privacy's sake, I stopped asking for details.
Album_Miro6: Some residents occasionally ask Miro for advice. Those whose secrets she discovered may consider her the only person with whom they can share their worries.
Album_Miro7: Miro seems able to show anyone reflected in her mirror an image of their dream fulfilled. She uses this ability to reveal people's dreams and encourage them. When I asked about her own dream, she shyly answered that she wanted many friends.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Miro: I will... always be watching over you.
Gacha_Result_Line2_Miro: Protagonist of a mirror ghost story
Miro_Spawn1: I-I feel dizzy, but let us do our best...!
Miro_Growth: I am Miro. A pleasure to meet you.
Miro_Growth1: I will work even harder so I can be of help!
Miro_Growth2: The mirror seems to sparkle even more brightly!
Miro_Victory1: Hehe... What do you think? D-did I do well?
Miro_Victory2: Everyone was so wonderful...! You were truly the best!
Miro_Defeat1: Ugh... It really is dangerous outside the mirror...
Miro_Defeat2: I should prepare a sturdier mirror next time...
Miro_Affinity1_1: Hehe... What side of yourself will you show me today?
Miro_Affinity1_2: I am still not used to being outside the mirror... so I am a little nervous.
Miro_Affinity2: I observed many different friends again today! S-sometimes they noticed me and I made them faint, but...
Miro_Affinity3: I want to watch over and support everyone... but I keep frightening them instead. The mirror ghost story only spreads farther... Uuugh...!
Miro_Affinity4: Sometimes even I wonder whether I truly am a ghost... but I will not become confused anymore...!
Miro_Affinity5: I hope everyone's words to themselves... do not end as mere monologues.
Miro_Affinity6: I will practice living outside the mirror so I can make more friends! If I fall... will you help me up?
Miro_Affinity7: Master, I will always be beside you, cheering you on...!
Miro_Die1: Uaaah~! I cannot hold on any longer... Sorry...!
Miro_Die2: Hng... Sorry I could not help...
Miro_LevelUp: Hehe... Thank you for always watching over me!
Miro_Equipment: Is this a convex mirror? Or a concave mirror?
Miro_HeroSkill: Now I can reflect things more clearly!
Miro_HeroUpgrade: Do not worry! I will always watch over you!
Miro_Board: Th-that way? Uaat, I am confused...!
Miro_DeckSetting2: Now... I will step out and help in person...!
Miro_Touch1: Ouch! D-did you catch me secretly watching...?
Miro_Touch1_1: Hing... D-did I do something wrong...?
Miro_Touch2_1: Mmm... I feel myself getting drowsy~
Miro_Touch1_2: Ugh... You will leave a mark on the mirror...
Miro_Touch2: H-hm? Were you... polishing my mirror?
Miro_Touch2_2: Through the mirror... I can feel the warmth of your hand.
Miro_DutchRubEnd2: Th-the mirror will break if you keep that up...!
Miro_Growth1_Skin1: I feel as though I never lose my sense of direction underwater.
Miro_Growth2_Skin1: This is my first time swimming, but it seems incredibly fun.
Miro_LevelUp_Skin1: Water play, start...! All right, all right...!
Miro_HeroSkill_Skin1: If you look like you might drown, I will catch you...!
Miro_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: Swim without worry! I will watch over you!
Miro_Touch1_1_Skin1: H-hehe. It is slippery, so it feels less painful.
Miro_Touch1_2_Skin1: Ugh... Do you not like my swimsuit...?
Miro_Touch2_Skin1: Ah, your hand will get wet if you touch me like that...
Miro_Touch2_2_Skin1: You will watch me swim... right?
Miro_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: If you keep doing that... I will take you underwater~!
Miro_Growth1_Skin2: I am Miro, headmistress of the Magic School!
Miro_Growth2_Skin2: It is not only a hammer! This is a Magic School! A Magic School!
Miro_LevelUp_Skin2: Even a great mage cannot neglect research!
Miro_Equipment_Skin2: Good tools make a good mage!
Miro_HeroSkill_Skin2: My dough... No, my magical technique has improved!
Miro_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Great! Even I am pleased with this paper!
Miro_Board_Skin2: I wonder if there are any promising students around?
Miro_Touch1_Skin2: Excuse me! I am not a lump of dough!
Miro_Touch1_1_Skin2: This violates school rules! School rules!
Miro_Touch1_2_Skin2: If you keep this up, I will not bake you any bread, okay?
Miro_Touch2_Skin2: Ehehe~ I am as happy as if I had gained a new student.
Miro_Touch2_1_Skin2: I will make you my apprentice specially! Would you like to learn magic?
Miro_Touch2_2_Skin2: This is nice! How should I put it? It feels as though I am under a spell.
Miro_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Would you like to take one hit from Panteo?
Miro_AsideGet: I want to be... closer than I look!
Miro_AsideUpgrade: I do not want to only watch...! Now... I will protect you!
Miro_SPSkill3: I want to hear your story.
Miro_Ultimate3: Th-there are too many eyes on me!
Miro_Gacha2: I will always be watching over you.
Miro_Gacha3: What kind of day will everyone have today?
Miro_Line1: What side of themselves will everyone show me today?
Miro_Line2: I am the Azure Dragon of Mirrors who cheers everyone on.
Miro_Line3: Is something wrong? Do not worry. I will listen to everything.
Miro_Lobby: I am not used to being watched by others.
Miro_LobbyEvent1: Master, thank you for your hard work for the Order today.
Miro_LobbyEvent2: Master, I will always be by your side cheering you on. Keep going.
LoveLetter_Miro:
Dear Master,

Hello! It is Miro. The mirror you prepared is comfortable, so I am doing well. Sometimes someone cleaning the Order comes and polishes it until it gleams, and sometimes they dance in front of me before leaving.

I also hear the things you mutter to yourself, Master. O-Of course, I have never told anyone! I will keep practicing here until I become accustomed to the world.

Thank you for everything!
LoveCall_Miro:
Ah, it c-connected! Hello? Can you hear me clearly?
I am still not used to entering numbers, so I called the wrong people several times. Hehe.
Just now I accidentally called Ashur, but we had a fun conversation!
I want to call my friends often from now on!

Hmm? Why did I call you?
Umm... Nothing happened!
I simply wanted to encourage you a little while you were working, Master! Hehe.
With a phone, I can talk to you anytime and anywhere...
so now I am happy that I can cheer for you even from far away!
Sometimes... when I want to hear your voice... may I call like this?
Because... your voice is a great encouragement to me too!

Hehe, thank you! I will call again next time.
Keep going today! I will always be behind you, cheering you on!
Affinity_Miro_EP01_001: I am still a little afraid to leave the mirror.
Affinity_Miro_EP01_002: You are still adapting, so take it slowly.
Affinity_Miro_EP01_003: Y-yes! Slowly... slowly... Whew. I feel a little calmer now.
Affinity_Miro_EP01_005: B-but I am frightened... Please do not pressure me, Master!
Affinity_Miro_EP01_007: I take walks often! Today I walked from this mirror all the way to that one!
Affinity_Miro_EP02_001: I received a letter today! I wonder what it says. Would you read it with me?
Affinity_Miro_EP02_002: I feel a little guilty reading someone else's letter.
Affinity_Miro_EP02_003: Oh! I had not thought of that. I will read it by myself. Thank you for pointing it out, Master!
Affinity_Miro_EP02_004: It looks like a letter of thanks from the residents. Did you do something for them?
Affinity_Miro_EP02_005: I traveled through the mirrors and encouraged residents as they began their day!
Affinity_Miro_EP02_006: That letter began in Monatium and...
Affinity_Miro_EP02_007: Huh? What? What do you mean? I received it from a Sprite, not an Elf.
Affinity_Miro_EP03_001: A witch friend asked me to observe Master and write down everything I see. What should I do?
Affinity_Miro_EP03_002: Just tell her what I cooked today.
Affinity_Miro_EP03_003: Huh? Will that be enough? Hmm... True. What Master cooked today is an observation record too! Understood.
Affinity_Miro_EP03_004: It is fine as long as nothing is too private.
Affinity_Miro_EP03_005: Oh, really? Hmm~ I suppose it would be nice to have a record of Master. Something about your magnificent exploits!
Affinity_Miro_EP03_007: O-of course! I am not an Elemental who goes around spreading other people's private affairs!
Affinity_Miro_EP04_003: Oh, I am practicing telling directions apart without a mirror. Someday I may be somewhere without one!
Affinity_Miro_EP04_004: The hand you eat with is your right hand.
Affinity_Miro_EP04_005: Oh... But I saw a friend eating with both hands before. C-could that friend have two right hands?! Two right hands?!
Affinity_Miro_EP04_006: Raise your right hand and lower your left.
Affinity_Miro_EP04_007: Raise... the right hand, and lower... the left. This is rather good training. Thank you, Master!
Affinity_Miro_EP05_001: Are stories about the ghost in the mirror still circulating these days?
Affinity_Miro_EP05_002: There are more stories about the mirror Elemental now.
Affinity_Miro_EP05_003: Really? Hehe. I am so happy the misunderstanding seems to be clearing up! I did not much like the ghost stories...
Affinity_Miro_EP05_005: Hmm... Many residents still misunderstand. I will have to work harder!
Affinity_Miro_EP05_006: I hear she appears every night.
Affinity_Miro_EP05_007: E-every night? Ugh, that is absolutely not me! You know that, Master, right? Truly?
Affinity_Miro_EP06_001: The Elven Intelligence Division asked me to share everything I knew about a certain target.
Affinity_Miro_EP06_002: They were not rude to you, were they?
Affinity_Miro_EP06_003: Ah, no! Everyone was kind. Hmm~ But they even asked about private matters, so it was a little awkward... yet I also felt excited, as if I were a secret agent.
Affinity_Miro_EP06_005: They said they were questioning people to track down the mayor's missing Americano. I told them everything I knew!
Affinity_Miro_EP06_006: That sounds similar to what you usually do.
Affinity_Miro_EP06_007: What? Th-that is too cruel! Someone might think I am a creepy Elemental! I am not that sort of Elemental!
Affinity_Miro_EP07_001: I was invited to a tea party! How should I dress?
Affinity_Miro_EP07_003: Huh, um... How? Tie my hair up high...? Th-that would be a little embarrassing...!!
Affinity_Miro_EP07_004: You mean decorating your mirror, right?
Affinity_Miro_EP07_005: No! I mean me. Am I the same thing as my mirror? Hmph!
Affinity_Miro_EP07_006: You look lovely just as you are.
Affinity_Miro_EP07_007: Oh, ehehe... That was not the advice I wanted, but it still makes me a little happy... Hehehe...
Affinity_Miro_EP08_001: I know what you did last night, Master!
Affinity_Miro_EP08_002: That is an invasion of privacy.
Affinity_Miro_EP08_003: I-it was only a joke... Was it not funny? I-I am sorry if I upset you...
Affinity_Miro_EP08_004: You were playing with me last night.
Affinity_Miro_EP08_005: Hehe. I want to play again today. Shall we invite the other Apostles this time?
Affinity_Miro_EP08_007: I am not a ghost! I told you, I am not a ghost! You are so cruel, Master! You are mean! Waaaah!
Affinity_Miro_EP09_001: I spent the entire day walking outside the mirrors, so I am a little tired...
Affinity_Miro_EP09_002: The entire day? You truly gathered your courage!
Affinity_Miro_EP09_003: Oh, you noticed? Hehe... Today was very difficult, but it was rewarding too... and I had a wonderful time!
Affinity_Miro_EP09_004: You must have worked up a sweat.
Affinity_Miro_EP09_005: D-do I smell of sweat? Ugh... I did not sweat very much... I-I will go wash!
Affinity_Miro_EP09_006: You worked hard. Have something delicious.
Affinity_Miro_EP09_007: It was not hard work. Hmm~ I made some new friends! Would you like to hear about them? Hehe!
Affinity_Miro_EP10_001: I polished the mirrors very diligently today! What do you think, Master?
Affinity_Miro_EP10_003: Hehe. Right? I scrubbed and scrubbed until they were perfectly clean! I think I can see Master even more clearly now.
Affinity_Miro_EP10_004: Are you certain you cleaned them properly?
Affinity_Miro_EP10_005: O-of course! I worked very hard on both the inside and outside... Are they dirty?
Affinity_Miro_EP10_007: Ugh... You have asked the important question. First, the one at the Order, and then one in each race's city... Um... How many is that?
Affinity_Miro_EP11_001: While I was taking a walk today, a resident looked at the mirror and screamed.
Affinity_Miro_EP11_003: When will people stop mistaking me for a ghost? Sigh... Today is a little... no, a very sad day.
Affinity_Miro_EP11_004: Do not worry. I explained everything for you.
Affinity_Miro_EP11_005: What? How? Oh... They reported it directly to the Order. Whew... Thank you, Master. I am relieved the misunderstanding was cleared up.
Affinity_Miro_EP11_007: But... they ran away screaming... They were too fast...
Affinity_Miro_EP12_001: Arco invited me to join a dance crew!
Affinity_Miro_EP12_002: I think you would be good at it.
Affinity_Miro_EP12_003: Hehe... Arco said the same thing. I declined the invitation, but Arco asked me to keep helping with dance practice, and I agreed!
Affinity_Miro_EP12_005: Hmm~ More than dancing itself, I love watching passionate dancers. Everyone looks so full of life.
Affinity_Miro_EP12_006: Joining the crew would be hard work.
Affinity_Miro_EP12_007: Oh... hard work... Hmm... It is a little tiring, but working together is so enjoyable that I do not mind!
Affinity_Miro_EP13_001: Looking at the world through a tiny fragment of mirror feels fascinating.
Affinity_Miro_EP13_003: Hmm~ The world visible through such a tiny gap is so vast that it almost overwhelms me. Everything looks enormous, and sometimes I feel very small.
Affinity_Miro_EP13_004: Perhaps it feels like a kaleidoscope?
Affinity_Miro_EP13_005: What? Ahaha. It is similar, but different. Seeing things from an unfamiliar perspective helps refresh my mood.
Affinity_Miro_EP13_006: It sounds as if you are peeping.
Affinity_Miro_EP13_007: Oh... M-Master, that is a bad thought. You should not think things like that!
Affinity_Miro_EP14_001: Master! Whenever you need help, write S.O.S on a mirror!
Affinity_Miro_EP14_002: How many seconds will it take you to see it?
Affinity_Miro_EP14_003: Um... If I am far away, I might see it late... Hmm. I am sorry. Just knock on the mirror instead.
Affinity_Miro_EP14_004: Would it not look like 202 from the inside?
Affinity_Miro_EP14_005: What? Master, a 2 and an S look entirely different. D-does your handwriting make them look similar...?
Affinity_Miro_EP14_006: What if I simply want to see you?
Affinity_Miro_EP14_007: Oh, oh! Of course that is fine! Call me anytime, not only when you need help!
Affinity_Miro_EP15_001: The night sky is so beautiful. I wish there were somewhere like it inside the mirrors.
Affinity_Miro_EP15_002: Let us go see the night sky together whenever you like.
Affinity_Miro_EP15_003: Really? You mean it? Hehe. I would love that, Master! Then how about tonight?
Affinity_Miro_EP15_004: The inside of a mirror sounds terribly frightening.
Affinity_Miro_EP15_005: What...? Elementals live inside mirrors too. It is not frightening at all, you know?
Affinity_Miro_EP15_006: Would looking at the city at night not be similar?
Affinity_Miro_EP15_007: Hmm... Saying they are similar ultimately means they are different...
Affinity_Miro_EP16_003: Hmm... Then would a still puddle also be a mirror?
Affinity_Miro_EP16_005: Not every piece of shiny glass is a mirror. Hmph. I heard your homeland even had mirrors made from bronze, Master!
Affinity_Miro_EP16_007: I am sorry I worried you! Nothing happened. I simply had the thought because so many unusual mirrors have appeared lately. Hehe.
Affinity_Miro_EP17_001: Um... Achoo! Sniff... I suddenly had to sneeze.
Affinity_Miro_EP17_002: Is it cold inside mirrors too?
Affinity_Miro_EP17_003: Ugh... I get cold when it is cold too! Touch a mirror on a cold day and you will understand!
Affinity_Miro_EP17_004: Cover your mouth when you sneeze.
Affinity_Miro_EP17_005: I-I am sorrachoo! I traveled around so much giving advice last night that I may have caught a cold. Achoo!
Affinity_Miro_EP17_006: Shall I dust your mirror for you?
Affinity_Miro_EP17_007: Achoo! Hachoo! Yes... May I ask you to? Haaa-choo!
Affinity_Miro_EP18_001: A ghost friend who sees dreams became angry and told me not to intrude on her territory.
Affinity_Miro_EP18_003: Um... Is that not a little childish? Master... I never knew you were somewhat childish...
Affinity_Miro_EP18_004: Your abilities are different, so do not worry about it.
Affinity_Miro_EP18_005: Ah... True. I show dreams to others, while she looks into other people's dreams.
Affinity_Miro_EP18_006: Tell her you can show her own dream to her.
Affinity_Miro_EP18_007: Oh! Master, what a brilliant solution! I think my ghost friend would like that too! I will run over and tell her immediately!
Affinity_Miro_EP19_001: Master, would you like to go on a picnic with me? The weather is wonderful today!
Affinity_Miro_EP19_002: Certainly. I will pack the lunch!
Affinity_Miro_EP19_003: Wow~ Wonderful! I am so excited to go on a picnic with Master. Shall we leave right now?
Affinity_Miro_EP19_004: It looks as if it is about to rain outside.
Affinity_Miro_EP19_005: What? Bright sunlight is dazzling. This is perfect picnic weather!
Affinity_Miro_EP19_006: The mirror might reflect the light and hurt your eyes.
Affinity_Miro_EP19_007: Ugh... I did not say I was bringing a mirror. I meant that I was going outside myself!
Affinity_Miro_EP20_001: A fortune-teller ghost friend asked whether I had seen her older sister inside a mirror.
Affinity_Miro_EP20_002: I think I have heard that story.
Affinity_Miro_EP20_003: You know about it too, Master? I apologized and said I did not know because I have never seen her. She asked me to tell her if I ever do!
Affinity_Miro_EP20_005: I have never seen another being besides myself in there... But if someone else exists, I would like to meet her.
Affinity_Miro_EP20_006: There is Miro inside the mirror.
Affinity_Miro_EP20_007: Um... That is true, but I feel as though you said it with a strange double meaning...
